lines.text: Esau plots to kill Jacob after mourning for their father, so Rebekah tells Jacob to flee to her brother Laban.
Isaac blesses Jacob and commands him not to marry a Canaanite woman, but to go to Paddan-aram.
Seeing that Isaac disapproved of Canaanite women, Esau goes to Nahor and marries Mahalath in addition to his other wives.
Jacob sleeps with a stone under his head and dreams of a tower with angels going up and down.
Jacob sets up the stone as a pillar, pours oil on it, names the place Bethel, and vows to give God a tenth.
